name: tapnow-local
description: 本地运行的类 TapNow 无限画布：节点式 AI 工作流，图片/视频等节点均可自定义 API

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs && dotnet publish desktop/TapNowLocal.csproj -c Release -o release
scripts.desktop:run: npm run build && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs && dotnet run --project desktop/TapNowLocal.csproj
